Frequently Asked Questions

What capacity options exist for hanging scales?

Our hanging weighing scales are available in capacities ranging from 50 kg to 600 kg, fitted with intrinsic safety locks against sudden impact loading.

Can the bench scale print custom barcode labels?

Yes. The electronic bench scale with label printing indicator features automated barcode and price-computing label printing for grocery, bakery, packaging, and retail checkout operations.
